coordinates: PDF points, origin top-left, y grows downward. Underscore run: the run's character box. Drawn rule: the rule's x extent and the 10 pt of writing room above it. Cell or box: its printed edges. Tick box: the printed square.
how_measured: Picture pages: white boxes found as connected white regions in each embedded JPEG at its own resolution (2049x2651 px for page 1 of the form, 1700x2200 px for the others), edges refined to the white/grey transition and over any drawn edge; converted to PDF points through the image drawing matrix read from each page (image drawn at x 33.75-573.75 pt, 698.25 pt tall; page clip y 27.75-583.75). Every picture looked at in full; overlays at 100 dpi looked at.

third_parties: custodian (custodian information, page 3; authorized signature, page 11)
financial advisor and branch manager/RIA (Section 6, page 14)
signing.kind: Subscription agreement form (5 form pages, each a picture split over two landscape PDF pages). The investor and a co-owner complete and sign Section 5; Section 4 has its own owner/co-owner signatures for bank distributions; a custodian or trustee signs where applicable; the financial advisor and branch manager sign Section 6. No issuer acceptance block.
signing.note: Each form page is one JPEG drawn across two PDF pages: the first shows picture rows down to y 583.75 pt, the second the rest (from y 27.75 pt). No place is cut by a page break. Dates are printed as three boxes (month / day / year), each a place.

sure_per_page.2: sure of every place; the aggregate price box shows a printed 0 (kept as a place, marked)
sure_per_page.5: sure; the two "Retired" boxes are read as tick boxes (marked)
sure_per_page.8: sure; the sample check is not a place
sure_per_page.11: sure; whose the custodian-or-trustee signature is, is a judgement (third party, marked)
sure_per_page.14: sure (boxes measured from the picture pixels)

2: the five letters O in the printed footer line are white specks, not boxes
the dark title bars and column heading bars
table rules of the account-type grid
3: the help bar and the footer line
the printed letters O in the footer
5: the thin vertical rule between columns A and B
the horizontal rule under place of birth
6: grey panel, help bar and footer only
8: the sample voided check picture: its white face, its printed rules (Date, Pay to the order of, $, memo) and the red outlined routing/account/check number boxes are an illustration, not places
9: the lower half of the sample check picture and its red callouts
11: the outlined W-9 certification box (text frame)
items (a) to (g) have no box to tick
12: legal text, help bar and footer
15: Section 7 payment instructions: printed bank details already filled in, including "[Investor Name]" in the wire reference (an instruction, not a blank)
